invariant_patterns.brief: A UNIQUE constraint on (sku, location) rejects a second row for the same pair at the DB level; the upsert path relies on it as its ON CONFLICT target.
sku is NOT NULL: inserting a row with a null sku is rejected by the database.
A CHECK (quantity >= 0) constraint rejects a negative quantity at write time; no negative stock is ever stored.
Filing an existing (sku, location) is a single atomic INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE: after the write exactly one row exists for the pair carrying the new quantity and tracking_code.

The initial create_table migration is reversible: after downgrade to its own down_revision and upgrade head, stock_records and its columns, UNIQUE(sku, location) and CHECK(quantity >= 0) constraints are present again (schema recreated; no row-survival claim for the initial create).
